trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy by definition, and it comes after the story, the 100% checklist, the Strangers & Freaks strands and the miscellaneous cleanup. Expect roughly 200 hours in total; PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 for difficulty, with the time, not the skill, being the real cost.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5).
Complete the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and any leftover trophies.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. You cannot miss it — just play the story. PowerPyx notes it is the opening mission, so it will be one of the first trophies you earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the story until you finish the Gone Fishing mission.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx says it pops when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins — in other words, play through Chapter 1 and it is yours. Before you leave Chapter 1, though, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude): it is the one thing in the chapter that may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the morning balcony meditation with Lucia.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City, per PowerPyx. Chapter 2 is also where the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia — that unlock matters for several later trophies, including the partner ones and the final meditation spot.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx says it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is a busy one for unlocks: Credit Check opens bank jobs, payday loans and the Dye Pack Jammer, and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission, then start Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Per PowerPyx it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 is where the big-money optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks bank vault robberies — do it when it appears, since vaults feed several trophies and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission — the story's ending, and the last chapter trophy. After the credits you return to free-roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and cheats unlock (do not use them on your platinum save: cheats disable trophies and saving).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the story's final mission.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to start the cleanup.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the named-mission trophies that pop as you play the story in order, so there is nothing special to do and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It pops as part of the story, so just keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks by playing the story, with no side requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It pops as part of the story — no preparation, no missable step.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks in the course of the story, so just keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last named-mission trophy before the finale, and it pops by playing the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: finish the in-game 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story. The good news, per PowerPyx, is that it is closer to 60% true completion — most requirements are partial (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges). The only parts that demand everything are the robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Nothing for 100% is missable, and progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every robbery line: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 vaults.
Finish the all-or-nothing lines: 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 15 Target Decks.
Top up the partial lines (vehicles, animals, cards, challenges) to their listed numbers.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds, per PowerPyx: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps, and you can mix them freely. Under the Bridges are the quickest — fly a plane under bridges. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Do any 250 stunts across the four categories.
Fastest: fly Under the Bridges in a plane.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The trophy tracker counts them, and you can see them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says you will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not chase it — check the Activities screen late in the game and mop up whichever type is still at zero.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done.
Do one of each of the 9 types; the story and 100% work cover most of them.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 shooting range locations. The 100% checklist also demands all 42, so this is a mandatory grind rather than a side quest. PowerPyx links a full location guide; the medals themselves are not considered very hard, but they take time. Practising here also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit all 12 Shooting Range locations.
Gold all 42 challenges (accuracy and speed both matter — replay until gold).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. PowerPyx lists 42 drone races in total across those 14 spots, and the 100% checklist also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials completed, so plan to finish every drone event, not just one win per location. Drone races are one of the few activity types the checklist demands in full.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find the 14 Top Fun locations and win a drone race at each.
Complete all 42 Drone Time Trials for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in total, per PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, plus 10 of 13 Race Challenge gold medals — so aim past 20 and keep racing. Races count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations.
Keep going to 30 wins and 10 race-challenge golds for 100%.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, follow the purple marker, and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are 4, per PowerPyx: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever you like best. The 100% checklist wants all 4 played.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play any of the 4 arcade games to the end of its levels.
The first three are on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Her questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. PowerPyx lists her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. All quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; answer Andy's call and follow her address in Belville.
Complete her five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. His questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure in shipwrecks — 7 sets in total, marked with purple chest icons; use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring the finds back. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason, calling Brian can speed it up). Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. The 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 sets.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Island Dreams (Chapter 1), answer Kenton's call and visit Key Lento.
Dive his marked shipwrecks and return the treasure, set by set, until the questline ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. PowerPyx lists his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. All quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete Billy's five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm and the chemical collections) and Yago (the street-race mentoring strand), plus Pilot Pete's delivery strand. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see your count, and keep playing stranger strands until it reaches 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find stranger strands in the open world (they are not the named character questlines).
Complete 8 counting strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. His questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso plus 15 more (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D). Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if he wants one, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3) to unlock the Key Cloner and the wish list.
Steal and deliver the 16 cars on Randy's list to his garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This — shutting down the labs — and the trophy pops. It all stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs.
Destroy labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then finish Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, per PowerPyx. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you cannot do the last spot until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she talks about meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. It raises the meditation counter by 1, though it is not marked as a spot like the others, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, before leaving Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy wants all of them. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept the balcony meditation.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate at all 18 spots — with both characters at each spot where possible.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is marked automatically some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County — it is Jason-only, Lucia cannot receive it. Meet Bret, and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animal he requests and bring it back to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. There are 15 Target Decks in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes naturally on the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: As Jason after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the unique animal he requests and bring it back.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, per PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them — so work on cards steadily and you will pass 3 sets long before 100%. Cards are found across Leonida; PowerPyx links a full set-by-set location guide. Any 3 complete sets count.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida until 3 full sets are complete.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Hold Up on the D-pad to open WAiNK instantly, then hold R1 on a scannable object. PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count. Scan everything you pass while playing: the same habit also feeds Whip It Good (scan 200 vehicles) and the 100% checklist's 100 WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you explore.
Any 100 scanned locations count — there are more than 100.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way — you can skip the 10 hardest challenges entirely. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom-right corner shows which are done. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work on other trophies first — most challenges complete passively.
Late in the game, open Progress > Challenges and finish the 50 easiest.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Then cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, and escape the red heat zone on a fast sports motorcycle; PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. In practice you will likely get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel helps.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (call your partner with hold Right + Triangle). Loot 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time; the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, so if it does not pop, hit a fourth. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. Wear an armored vest and carry Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level (jewelry stores in north Vice City work well).
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The easiest way, per PowerPyx: open the WAiNK app (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan vehicles — a busy road is the fastest spot.
Keep scanning to 200 base models for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies and drop them quickly; PowerPyx suggests criminals at Gang Operations, an assault rifle like the Duke 556, and body armor from Ammu-Nation. Note that it reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus Level 4 this is much easier, and it may pop naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Buff focus (food/drink, Adrenaline) and raise Focus toward level 4.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down 5 criminals in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and take off. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — planes sitting on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx says the easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to VCIA and find the passenger plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it, reach the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. PowerPyx has a full route with screenshots; expect heavy resistance on the base, so be ready to fight your way in and out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot. Stay quiet and unseen throughout: if the alarm goes off or you are spotted, it does not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, loot the safe unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): it is marked automatically from story progress and introduces vault robberies — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry all the cash). After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (finish his earlier quests first if needed — two Payday Loan robberies). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so you will pass 5 on the way. A single vault can pay up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) to unlock vault robberies.
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each) and rob 5 vaults, escaping each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and you will get this automatically while doing Maximum Withdrawal. To get it earlier, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so use a Pay 'n' Spray or get clear of the zone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Either follow That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) — the vault robbery counts.
Or blow open a roaming armored truck with a sticky bomb, then escape the heat radius.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest method, per PowerPyx, is to take a plane and fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do this after you have opened up the map through the story, and combine it with WAiNK scanning and vehicle spotting while you fly around.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Take a plane and fly over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 Gang Operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob Illegal Operations (yellow map icons) until one per gang is done.
Keep going — all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — KeenGamer lists it as 'exact trigger still being confirmed', and PowerPyx currently lists this trophy as unknown. What the official description pins down is the place and the act: Ocean Beach, a cocktail, a view. Try the beachfront bars and cafés along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and linger at a spot with a view over the water. If it does not pop, check back against the cited guides — this entry will be updated as players confirm the trigger. Do not trust any guide that claims a precise spot without a source.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar or café with a view.
Order a cocktail there and stay at the viewpoint; the exact trigger is still unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed — both KeenGamer and PowerPyx list this trophy's method as unknown as of the game's launch week. The description itself is the hint: take a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. Try the vehicle showrooms around Vice City with a car already inside, and check the cited guides for a confirmed method as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City and drive a car out through the front.
The exact method is still unconfirmed — verify against the cited guides.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, one of the Gang Operations. PowerPyx gives the full method: go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (marked automatically), buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first, and inside take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while — go back and take what is left, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
During Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2), take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe's contents.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, per character (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership, and always go together with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with both characters together until both reach maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action affects your reputation. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and finally Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since cops become far more aggressive. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this should come passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx notes you can farm it quickly, but keep the Irredeemable warning in mind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward 500.
Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — but no guide has confirmed what, as of launch week. The honest advice is to play through the prologue's Payday Loans content, and if something fails once, try it again; then verify against the cited guides as players confirm the trigger. Do not trust a precise method that cites no source.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play the prologue's Payday Loans content; retry anything that fails once.
Method still unconfirmed — check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description suggests a strange, one-off event — the kind of thing that happens when you stumble into the game's UFO content. Explore Leonida's oddities and watch for UFO-related stranger content; as players confirm the questline, the cited guides will pin down the trigger. Until then, treat any exact method without a source as a guess.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Look for UFO-related stranger content around Leonida.
Method still unconfirmed — verify against the cited guides.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed — KeenGamer notes it is a melee drive-by with the exact method unconfirmed, and PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The working method to try: ride a motorcycle, pull up alongside an enemy and kick them with a melee attack while moving, knocking them down. Repeat until it pops; if the kick alone does not trigger it, check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Ride a motorcycle and melee-kick enemies while driving past them.
Method still being confirmed — verify against the cited guides.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to bring it at once. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Fence $250,000 of marked bills in total — Yasmani in Vice City pays best.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, per PowerPyx — they are the most expensive purchases. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, plus Pay 'n' Sprays. Spending counts across every shop type, and the 100% checklist's robbery and fencing work will leave you with plenty of cash to spend.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Spend $100,000 across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties. (There are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count.) Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. All 8 cost $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the app.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots for more registrations. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the Moses mission (Chapter 2) to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages for parking spots, then register 10 cheap stolen vehicles with Moses.
